sentences.text: Ms. Mrinal Gopal Elkar, learned counsel accepts notice on behalf of the State of Madhya Pradesh.

3.
Service of formal notice on the respondent-State of Madhya Pradesh rashmi dhyani pant Date:
2026.02.05 17:35:52 IST stands dispensed with.

Reason:
4. Till the next date of hearing, the petitioner shall not be arrested in connection with FIR No.1224 of 2023 dated 09th December, 2023 registered at Police Station Pannagar, District Jabalpur, Madhya Pradesh under Sections 420 & 34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860, subject to the petitioner joining investigation as and when called upon to do so by the investigating officer.
5. Counter affidavit be filed within two weeks, with indication of whether the petitioner was called upon by the investigating officer to join investigation and the outcome thereof.
6. Rejoinder thereto, if any, be filed within a week thereafter.

(RASHMI DHYANI PANT) (SUDHIR KUMAR SHARMA) ASST. REGISTRAR-CUM-PS COURT MASTER (NSH)
